Click Here to check out their site Built on the Wildwood Mjolnir platform this limited edition version of the Mjolnir is loaded with a pair vintage ITT 1N34A Diodes. The 1N34A diodes are part of the formula that makes the original "K" style pedal so special and when installed into this Mjolnir board we were shocked with how much it replicates the sound of Zach's original unit. The amount of gain is the same, voicing, output, it's all there and tweaked in just the right way. We're offering these in Silver and Gold finishes and the design is reminiscent of their inspiration. If you're looking for the closest sonic replica of those original "K" pedals then look no further.
